sections.title: Core Foundations & Conceptual Framework
sections.content:
• **Shift from Primary to Manufactured/Services**: India's historical trade composition has evolved from exporting raw materials and agricultural commodities to high-value manufactured goods, engineering goods, electronics, and modern **commercial services** (IT/ITeS).
• **Import Basket Vulnerability**: India's import composition remains heavily dominated by **crude oil, petroleum products, gold, and electronic components**, exposing the economy to imported inflation and exchange rate volatility.
• **Global Value Chain (GVC) Integration**: Modern trade composition analysis evaluates 'gross exports' versus **'domestic value added (DVA)'** exports to measure true economic gains from international trade.
• **Key Metric / Factor**: Merchandise trade deficit offset by services trade surplus, dictating the overall current account balance dynamics.

items.title: Major Geographical Distribution / Regional Hubs
items.content:
• **Export Hubs**: Western and Southern states (Gujarat, Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka) drive India's merchandise and electronics exports due to port connectivity.
• **Major Trading Partners**: USA, UAE, China, EU, and Saudi Arabia constitute over 40% of India's total bilateral trade composition.

items.title: Challenges, Reforms & Forward Strategy
items.content:
• **Bottlenecks / Issues**: High logistics costs (approx. 13-14% of GDP), inverted duty structures, and low R&D spending limiting high-tech product exports.
• **Policy Interventions**: PM GatiShakti, National Logistics Policy (NLP), District as Export Hubs initiative, and Free Trade Agreements (FTAs) with UAE, Australia, and EFTA.

items.title: Mnemonic for Top 4 India Import Commodities
items.content:
• **Memory Acronym / Phrase**: **"PEGS"** (Petroleum, Electronics, Gold, Machinery)
• **Decoded Meaning**: P - Petroleum/Crude, E - Electronic Goods, G - Gold/Jewellery, S - Machinery/Steel.
• **Prelims Exam Value**: Instantly eliminates incorrect options in questions asking about India's largest import items by value.

items.title: Retention Rule of Thumb
items.content: • **Core Formula / Rule**: India exports *Finished Engineering & Services* but imports *Raw Energy & High-Tech Components*.

upscNotes.content: Examiner Trap: UPSC frequently states that 'Agri-products constitute the largest share of India's export basket.' This is INCORRECT; Engineering goods and Petroleum products are significantly larger.
Mains Value Addition: Quote the Economic Survey data showing India's services exports crossing $300 billion and emphasize the transition from low-value merchandise to tech-intensive GVC integration.

keyTakeaways: Engineering goods and petroleum products dominate India's merchandise export and import baskets respectively.
Services trade surplus plays a vital structural role in mitigating structural merchandise trade deficits.
Policy shifts like PLI, FTAs, and logistics reforms are crucial for upgrading India's position in Global Value Chains.
